 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 465/2018 of Police Station K.N. Katju Marg for offence under Section 498A/406/506/377/34 IPC & Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and submits that State has no serious objection to this petition.
3. Respondent no. 2 identified by IO/SI Yagdutt accepts notice.
4. For recording statements of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 17.04.2026.
